entrance: The Scarlet Monastery at the eastern end of Tirisfal Glades, at /way 85.1 31.4. Each wing has its own door; this one is open to everyone.

1050.objective: Find the book Mythology of the Titans and bring it to Librarian Mae Paledust in Ironforge.
1050.note: It stands on the shelves of the Gallery of Treasures.

96800.objective: Find the book The Lost Magic of the Runemasters and bring it to Magus Olvek in Dalaran.

1053.objective: Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod and Houndmaster Loksey and report back to Raleigh the Devout in Southshore.
1053.note: The end of a chain that starts with Brother Anton. The bosses are spread over the Library, the Armory and the Cathedral.

1113.objective: Collect 20 Hearts of Zeal from the Scarlet Crusade.
1113.note: They drop from Scarlet bosses and monsters in all four wings. The quest follows Going, Going, Guano! from Razorfen Kraul.

1160.objective: Find The Beginnings of the Undead Threat in the Athenaeum and bring it to Parqual Fintallas in the Undercity.
1160.note: Part of a long chain that starts with Test of Faith.

1049.objective: Find the Compendium of the Fallen in the Athenaeum and bring it to Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff.
1049.note: Undead cannot pick up this quest.

1048.objective: Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod and Houndmaster Loksey and report back to Varimathras in the Undercity.
1048.note: The bosses are spread over the Library, the Armory and the Cathedral.

1951.objective: Find the book Rituals of Power in the Athenaeum and bring it to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.
1951.note: A Mage quest at the end of a chain that starts with Journey to the Marsh, from Magus Tirth in Thousand Needles.
